title: Unbounded 15-Agent Swarm Configuration Example
description: Demonstrates an unbounded, zero-queuing, 15-agent parallel swarm configuration for Swarm Engine.
mission: Architect and deploy high-throughput real-time collaborative workspace microservice

agents.taskSpec: Define shared message protocols, WebSocket payload interfaces, and blackboard contracts.
Design PostgreSQL schemas for workspaces, document revisions, and user access records.
Implement transactional repository queries for revision history and workspace membership.
Build WebSocket server handling client connection lifecycles, heartbeats, and room subscriptions.
Implement operational transformation and CRDT state synchronizer for real-time document conflict resolution.
Implement JWT and API key authentication middleware for WebSocket handshakes and HTTP routes.
Configure Redis pub/sub multi-node broadcasting for cross-server WebSocket message dissemination.
Build RESTful endpoints for workspace management, invitations, and metadata retrieval.
Generate isomorphic TypeScript client library with automatic reconnection and event emitters.
Author comprehensive unit tests covering CRDT conflict resolution and message serialization.
Author integration tests spinning up mock WebSocket clients verifying multi-user synchronization.
Audit WebSocket frame boundaries, injection vulnerabilities, and denial-of-service protections.
Develop load testing scripts simulating 10,000 concurrent WebSocket connections and measure latency.
Create optimized multi-stage Dockerfile and docker-compose orchestration with Redis and Postgres.
Write developer architecture guide, protocol specification, and client integration manual.
